summary: IQM Quantum Computers Oyj filed a Form 6-K reporting a stock exchange release regarding the transfer of 43,255 own shares to Board members as annual remuneration, per the June 12, 2026 AGM resolution. No acquisition, divestiture, or strategic event; it is a routine share transfer to directors. No price, premium, or deal terms are disclosed. The filing is a standard disclosure for a foreign private issuer. There is no special-situation element; it is purely a board compensation matter.
